decision_basis: 14% organic growth, strong backlog and improved FCF provide real compounding support, but debt more than doubled to fund acquisitions at 44.02x trailing/27.40x forward earnings. Margin compression and adjustment-heavy guidance offset the upside; overbought timing adds caution.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: current demand is strong, but the financing change is large relative to cash and entry valuation.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
